intelligence.company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies the API lifecycle, enabling developers to build, test, manage, and distribute APIs. It powers the development of over 500,000 companies worldwide and supports enterprise‑scale collaboration.
intelligence.target_audience: Engineers and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs.

intelligence.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source developer platform that provides managed PostgreSQL databases, authentication, real‑time, storage, and edge functions. It empowers startups, enterprises, and AI builders to rapidly prototype and scale applications without managing infrastructure.
intelligence.target_audience: Supabase targets developers, startups, enterprises, and innovation teams building data‑centric and AI‑powered applications on Postgres.

intelligence.company_overview: Vapi offers a unified platform for building, deploying, and improving voice agents at scale, enabling organizations to create conversational experiences for their customers. It provides orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade configurability to support millions of calls with low latency.
intelligence.target_audience: Small businesses to global enterprises that need a scalable, secure voice agent platform for customer support, sales, and engagement.
